title: Refresh hourly; a run with only the snapshot and the coordinator's revision opens no PR
goal: The views refresh every hour without a PR per hour when no component changed
acceptance: refresh-views.yml runs on cron '17 * * * *' and its header cites the owner decision of 2026-11-25
tools/views-changed.mjs ignores the snapshot time and every line carrying this repository's own revision; test/views-changed.test.mjs failed before the fix and passes after
.solution.json sets the coordinator emoji 🚦; README, the style guide and the regenerated dashboard show it
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
validation: check:fast; final applicable CI; scheduled runs over the next day
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one cron, one extracted check with a test, two doc lines. Not a measurement.
